transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Doctor. Well, what brings me in is that I've just... stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going. 

I'm not going out to salsa nights or church gatherings anymore. I haven't been cooking for the neighbors like I usually do. Honestly, I don't even want to walk into my shop just to enjoy the smell of the wood right now, and I've been a carpenter a long time. I just don't have the interest in any of it lately.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest in things you normally enjoy?

It's been about two months now. It started right around the time my wife's health suddenly declined. Our daily routine just... changed completely, and that's really when this whole shift in my mood and behavior began.
Besides losing interest in things, how has your mood been overall these past two months? Would you say you're feeling sad, empty, or down most days?

Yeah, empty is probably the right word for it. Most mornings, I wake up with this... this really heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It's honestly like all the color has just gone out of the house. I spend a lot of my time just having to force myself not to break down crying in front of my wife. So yeah, it's been a very down, heavy feeling most days.
Before these past two months, have you ever experienced a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt depressed or lost interest in things the way you're describing now?

Actually, thinking about it... the depression itself has really been dragging on for about six months now. The last two months have been the worst of it, with my wife's health and all, but... yeah, I've been feeling this way for a while before that. It’s been going on long enough now that I know it’s not just a bad week or, you know, ordinary stress. It's been a solid six months of this.
Before these past six months, have you ever had another period—even if it was years ago—where you felt this kind of depression or emptiness lasting at least two weeks?

No, honestly, I don't think so. I mean... I've had stressful times before, sure, like anyone. But nothing that felt like this emptiness, or where it just stayed with me for weeks on end. Before this started six months ago, I was always pretty steady. So, no, nothing like this in the past.

When you think back to six months ago, before you started feeling this way—was there a specific event or change that happened right around the time the depression began, or did it seem to come on gradually without any particular trigger?

No, I don't think there was any specific event. I mean... I can't really point to one thing that set it off. It just seemed to come on gradually. One week things just felt a bit harder to do, and then... it just kept getting heavier over time until it was that solid emptiness I mentioned. So, no, no particular trigger that I can think of. It just sort of crept up on me.

When you say the depression came on gradually over six months—do you mean that six months ago you first started noticing these feelings, or could it have started even earlier than that and you're just marking six months as when it became really noticeable?

Well, I think it really started right around that six-month mark. That's when I first noticed things shifting. Before that, I was fine. But for about six months now, it's just been dragging on... and it's been going on long enough that it became clear to me it wasn't just a bad week or ordinary stress from work. So, yeah, I'd say six months ago is when it actually began.

You mentioned that before these past six months you were always pretty steady. During those years before this depression started, did you ever have any periods—even shorter ones, maybe a few weeks—where you felt notably down or depressed, even if they weren't as severe or long-lasting as what you're experiencing now?

No, not really. I mean... I've had bad days, sure. You know, being a carpenter, the work gets stressful or tiring sometimes. But... nothing like a few weeks of feeling down or depressed. I was always just a pretty steady guy. Wake up, go to work, come home. I really don't remember ever having a stretch where I felt low like that before all this started.
